decision.explanation: The query asks for the composer of 'Symphony No. 38'. The provided documents explicitly identify three distinct composers for works titled 'Symphony No. 38': Joseph Haydn (Document 1, D1S3), Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (Document 5, D5S4), and Michael Haydn (Document 7, D7S2). These represent distinct valid referents (different people with works sharing the same number/title). Ludwig van Beethoven (Document 4, D4S4) is mentioned in the context of 'Symphony No. 38', but the text structure ('...renowned for his Symphony No. 38, a masterpiece...') appears to be a hallucination or error in the source text, as Beethoven did not compose a Symphony No. 38 (his symphonies are numbered 1-9). The audit label 'wrong_argument' for Beethoven confirms this discrepancy. Therefore, only the three composers with verified works matching the specific title in the source text are included.
